A '''tight-beam emitter''' was a tool that was found in [[vehicle repair kit]]s. With some modification, such as the removal of the [[energy cartridge]] and replacing it with a [[pivar spinner]] from a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], a tight-beam emitter could be rigged to emit [[mag-particle]]s which could disrupt the commands between a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] and its [[Droid caller/Legends|caller]].
